steps.title: Identify
steps.copy: Assess the shoulder position, range and pressing patterns that reproduce the issue.

steps.title: Improve
steps.copy: Use targeted drills to improve the movement or control that is missing.

steps.title: Strengthen
steps.copy: Build strength around the shoulder and pressing positions that matter.

steps.title: Apply
steps.copy: Adjust bench and upper-body training so you can keep progressing while symptoms settle.
